genius.notes: CADD's issuer terms identify Tetra Trust Company as the Canadian issuer acting through CAD Digital. No public U.S. permitted-issuer approval, state-qualified approval, OCC application, or GENIUS foreign-issuer registration was located for Tetra Trust/CADD. The GENIUS framework remains in proposed-rules phase and is not yet effective.
